name: autovacuum_analyze_threshold
description: Minimum number of row insertions, updates, or deletions in a table that triggers an autovacuum ANALYZE operation.
symptoms: Query performance regression after bulk DML
tuning_tips: Increase this value for large, stable tables to reduce ANALYZE frequency; decrease for volatile small tables needing fresher stats. Prefer combining with autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor for proportional tuning.
